description: A weight card with a straight-line trend, dots on each month and the latest value in the header.
overview: Ten monthly weights drawn with `type="linear"` and a dot on every reading, plus a larger dot for the touched point. A value axis on the right covers a fixed range, and the tooltip formats values in kilograms. The header shows the latest weight and the change since January as static text.
usage: Replace the weight array in `chartData` and update the header text to match. Adjust the `YAxis` `domain` and `ticks` for your range. The component takes no props.
